The Ray-Marching Algorithm - Scratchapixel
The name "ray-marching" can easily be understood now: we march along the ray, taking small regular steps as shown in Figure 1 (an example of backward ray-marching). Please note that using regular steps is not a condition of the ray marching algorithm. Steps can be irregular as well but to keep things simple for now, let's work with regular steps or strides (as Ken Musgrave liked to call them ...
